name: Full gates funnel PR
command: nix develop --command bash -c "make test && make test-scripts && make test-web && make lint && make lint-web && make vet && make build && shellcheck src/*.sh && shfmt -d src/*.sh && hadolint Dockerfile Dockerfile.supervisor"; echo "gates_exit=$status"
description: Full pre-push gate suite for the funnel-default PR (Go tests, scripts, web, lint, vet, build, shellcheck, shfmt, hadolint)
